verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document API versioning or a general deprecation policy. The only related item is a single service-change notice for SIP media applications, which includes migration guidance and states that existing customers can keep using PSTN Audio. That is a one-off product change, not a documented deprecation policy or a versioned API scheme, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
